data.one_liner: Lightweight reactive state management for Flutter with fine-grained reactivity
data.what_it_does: PipeX provides a simple, fine‑grained reactive system using Pipe, Hub, Sink, and Well. It automatically manages lifecycles and rebuilds only widgets that depend on changed state.
use_when: Need minimal boilerplate for state updates
Prefer a declarative API without streams
avoid_when: Complex async workflows that benefit from stream APIs
Large applications that already use a DI framework like get_it or provider
strengths: Good performance due to direct element manipulation
weaknesses: Limited ecosystem compared to Riverpod or Provider

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Riverpod offers a mature, DI‑friendly state management solution with a larger ecosystem and more features.
